CardDescription.DefaultText:
Its wood is low weight and easy to work, but of low quality.

Its twigs can be used for weaving and its bark can be processed into twine or used as an analgesic.
CardDescription.Text: 其木材重量轻、易加工，但品质较低。\n\n其嫩枝可用于编织，树皮可加工成细线或用作止痛药。
